title: His first European trip in 1968, arranged through Hugues Panassie
summary: After the Toronto record came out he first went to Europe in 1968; Hugues Panassie, whom he met in 1938, was the main reason, with fans waiting to see him.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan
